description: License compliance policy for the DrAbdulmalek account. All first-party projects are MIT (roadmap P5). This file is the hard barrier checked by license_audit.py before any third-party integration: GPL/AGPL and non-commercial code must never be imported as a library inside first-party repos. Approved pattern: consume it as a separate CLI/service exchanging files only. Format is JSON (not YAML) so the audit runs on the Python standard library alone with zero third-party dependencies.
forbidden_use_note: CC-BY-NC-* is a glob covering every Creative Commons non-commercial variant (CC-BY-NC, CC-BY-NC-SA, CC-BY-NC-ND, any version). 'custom non-commercial' is enforced heuristically: any SPDX id containing 'noncommercial'/'non-commercial' (e.g. LicenseRef-NONCOMMERCIAL-*) is forbidden, and licenses GitHub cannot auto-identify (spdx_id NOASSERTION) are flagged for manual review.

consumption_modes.library: Imported/linked as a dependency inside first-party code. Only allowed-license entries may use this mode.
consumption_modes.service: Runs as a separate long-lived service; integration is via files/API only.
consumption_modes.cli: Invoked as a standalone command-line tool; integration is via files only.
consumption_modes.non-commercial-experiments: Permitted for non-commercial experiments only; must never ship inside MIT first-party products.
consumption_modes.unassigned: No approved mode yet. Entry must be resolved (verify_before_integration) before any integration.

notes: First-party rule: every repo owned by the account that is not a fork must carry the default_license (MIT). A missing license file is a violation.
Forks are inspection tools, not integrations: a fork carrying a forbidden license is a warning (contamination vector), not an automatic failure. Never copy fork code into first-party repos.

Watchlist entries with an approved non-library mode (service / cli / non-commercial-experiments) may carry a forbidden license without failing the audit; importing them as a library (consumption: library) is always a violation.
The audit fetches each watchlist repo_slug and reports license drift when upstream re-licenses.
Unknown SPDX ids are warnings (unclassified) on first-party repos; add them to the correct list after manual review.
Exit codes of license_audit.py: 0 clean (warnings allowed), 1 violations found, 2 config/API error.
